notes.title: 💥 Update 1.2 – MONSTERS HAVE INVADED FANTASY BALL! 🤪⚽
notes.notes:
[h1]🚨 INVASION ALERT 🚨[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33195363/dc0536f53bba57ffd0eedc29a611936a99b9acd3.png[/img]

[h2]A horde of orcs has invaded Fantasy Ball! These new bots are ready to train with you… or just smash everything in sight.[/h2]

[h3]➡️ Their technique? Smashing the ball like barbarians.
➡️ Their strategy? None.
➡️ Their reaction to the new magic ball? “OOOH, SHINY!” 🤩[/h3]

Yes, goodbye to the old leather ball! It’s time for a sparkling magic ball ✨. More beautiful, more powerful… and even more unpredictable!

So, ready to dive into this enchanted chaos? Good luck… and watch out for the over-excited monsters! 💀⚡

notes.title: Credits and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]CREDITS[/b]
It's always important to credit people who worked on a game.
This is now done !
On the "Match Settings" panel, you now have a new "Credits" button, allowing you to see who is the formidable small team behind Fantasy Ball.


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
We've identified some bugs that we have fixed.

notes.title: Warrior, Controller and Performances Update
notes.notes:
Greeting Champions !

We have updated the way the Warrior plays !
It now uses its weapon to strike the ball or any other participants in its range!

We've also increased the number of controller supported, and made possible to play with the keyboard!

Have fun!

notes.title: Play Fantasy Ball OnLine with Parsec!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !

Do you know Parsec ?
https://parsecgaming.com/

Parsec is a "Simple, low latency game streaming" software that allows you to stream your computer and share it with your friends.

But the best part is that when friends join your stream, if they plug a controller on their own computer, the input will be received as if the controller was plugged on the host computer ... alowing you to play any Local-Multiplayer only games, such as Fantasy Ball, and play it OnLine!

You can even create a "Party Finder" to find players from all over the world to play Fantasy Ball with you!

I was even able to play Fantasy Ball on my phone (because yes, there is a phone app as well!) with my Wireless XBox controller linked with my phone with Bluetooth!

You can now extend your couch gaming experience ;)

Have fun!

-Arnaud, Solo Indie Game Developer of Fantasy Ball

notes.title: New Arena Revealed: The Ice Rink!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's time to reveal the new Arena that has been added with the latest update, the Ice Rink!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33195363/2eefc3c3ab9280b789ef14d6f5cf065b47f04ec0.png[/img]

This new Arena has a round shape and no collisions, but as you would expect from ice, it's very slippery!

Get ready for incredible shots!

Enjoy the freshness!

notes.title: New Arena Revealed: The Beach!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The latest update is now available, including a new Arena!

Here is The Beach!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33195363/09345996a43d9d4febc8c0733cb21ca81c8dbb97.jpg[/img]

This Arena is circular in design and there is no obstacle, but the ball doesn't bounce and is slowed by the sand!

Players really need to get close to the ball!

Give it a try, it's available right now!

notes.title: New Arena Revealed: The Pirate Boat
notes.notes:
Ahoy Everyone!

We are happy to announce that a new Map has been added to the current roster of Maps with the latest update.

Here is the Pirate Boat!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33195363/55d963a659bb8ab3b7499975d784848988b5ad60.png[/img]

Like The Witch House Map, The Pirate Boat has a circular design but with a squared collision in the middle that gives some randomness to the ball bounces. It also has floating flags for goal claim and sharks circling in water!

And like any other Map, it has it's own awesome music theme !

The current roster is now:
- Squared Design: Castle, Village, Forest, Graveyard
- Round Design: Witch, Pirate

YaaRRRrrr!

notes.title: New Arena Revealed : The Witch House
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !

Here is the new Arena that will be playable for the Early Access.
The Witch House
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33195363/313c8f1668918fa796ca212e439d97404a4b0bce.png[/img]

This arena has a circular design, different from the other squared arenas.
There is no obstacles on the field.
The white circle in the middle changes color to the leading player's color and a few effects celebrate players goals.

The full Arena pool for the Early Access will be of 4 squared maps and 1 round map:
- Castle
- Village
- Forest
- Graveyard
- Witch House

During the Early Access, we will introduce new Arenas, with a plan of 10 different Arenas for the release.

Hope you like it !
